CloneNameIntro: The AI heard the voice. Give it a name.
CloneSampleIntro: Record {0} to {1} seconds of natural speech: one person only, in a quiet room, with no music. Or choose a recording of the voice.
CloneSaved: Voice saved. It is in the effects.
CloneTip1: Record in a quiet room with no echo. Curtains, rugs and furniture help. Turn off music, TV and fans.
CloneTip2: Use the microphone you call with, a hand's width from your mouth, and keep that distance the whole time.
CloneTip3: Speak the way you always do and let your tone move, like in a conversation: ask something, tell a story, read a passage slowly.
CloneTip4: One to three minutes gives the best result. Under 30 seconds the voice loses detail.
CloneTip5: Only one person speaking. Avoid long laughs, coughs and long pauses.
CloneTip6: If you use a file, pick a clean recording with no background music. Voice messages from chat apps usually lose quality.
CloneUsageTip: Turn the Pitch until it is close to the cloned voice and try to copy the person's pace. The AI learns your own voice by itself the first time, so use the microphone and the place you will use it in, or learn it again.
